About Praescient Analytics

Praescient Analytics is a leader in delivering advanced analytic, data engineering, and technology integration solutions in support of the Department of Defense (DoD), Intelligence Community, and federal law enforcement. Our mission is to empower analysts and decision-makers through data-driven insights, enabling faster and more effective mission outcomes.

Position Overview

Praescient Analytics is seeking an experienced IT Systems Administrator to support a U.S. Army program. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in systems administration, network management, and server operations within secure environments. This individual will install, configure, maintain, and optimize IT systems and infrastructure to ensure consistent performance, security, and reliability across classified and unclassified networks.

Key Responsibilities

• Install, configure, and maintain local area networks (LAN), wide area networks (WAN), data communication systems, and both physical and virtual servers.
• Monitor system performance and verify the integrity and availability of hardware, network, and server resources.
• Review system and application logs; verify successful completion of scheduled jobs such as system backups.
• Analyze server and network utilization and manage user access controls and permissions.
• Perform software installation, upgrades, and license management.
• Support network modeling, analysis, and planning to optimize infrastructure performance and capacity.
• Conduct regular system administration tasks and maintain accurate system logs and documentation.
• Identify and implement system improvements, upgrades, and corrective actions in line with program requirements.
• Manage and operate tool permissions, deploy new tools and servers, and maintain system documentation.
• Develop and maintain IT application documentation, system specifications, and test plans per established standards and methodologies.

Required Qualifications

• Active TS/SCI clearance required.
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (or equivalent experience).
• 5+ years of experience in system administration within a DoD or federal environment.
• Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux operating systems administration.
• Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).
• Strong understanding of network protocols, firewall management, and system security practices.
• Familiarity with backup/recovery tools, system patching, and monitoring utilities.
• Excellent troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

• Relevant technical certifications (e.g., CompTIA Security+, Network+, Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator, or VMware Certified Professional).
• Experience supporting Army or other DoD enterprise IT environments.
• Knowledge of system accreditation and RMF compliance processes.

Benefits

• Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience
• Comprehensive, Company paid healthcare for you (We pay your premiums and deductibles)
• 401(k) with company match
• Travel & performance incentives
• 3 weeks paid time off (plus Federal Holidays)
• $5K annual training allowance
• $500 book allowance
• Tuition reimbursement program

Praescient Analytics is a Certified Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB) with over a decade of expertise in advanced analytics, engineering, and DevOps, specializing in transforming complex data into actionable intelligence for informed decision-making. Since 2011, we have supported over 40 organizations across diverse domains, including military intelligence operations, financial and fraud investigations, and insider threat detection.

Our team of experts—skilled in cloud computing, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, DevOps, and engineering—brings deep experience in solving complex challenges. With a proven track record in federal contracting, we deliver tailored, high-impact solutions designed to enhance operational efficiency, ensure mission success, and address the evolving needs of our clients. Praescient's innovative and adaptive approach makes us a trusted partner in delivering data-driven insights and technological excellence for critical missions.

Applicants selected will be subject to a government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

US Citizenship Required

Interested Candidates: Please forward your resume to recruiting@praescientanalytics.com and please visit our website to apply online at www.praescientanalytics.applicantstack.com/x/openings.

## Description

Northrop Grumman Aeronautics Systems (NGAS) has an exciting career opportunity for a Systems Administrator/Principal Systems Administrator to join the Ground Segment team of qualified, diverse individuals in support of the MQ-4C Triton program test activities. This position will be located at NAS (Naval Air Station) Patuxent River, MD.

The Triton – MQ-4C ITT (Integrated & Test Team) is a US Navy & Northrop Grumman combined test team working together to ensure future capabilities are tested and evaluated in an efficient manner. The selected candidate will perform a variety of data collection and technical support services on the Triton Air vehicle and Ground Control Stations; and support the research and procurement of MQ-4C unmanned air vehicle components in direct support of life cycle sustainment.

The selected candidate will be responsible for providing System Administrator level technical support services on the MQ-4C Triton Air vehicle and Ground Control Stations which includes engineering integration/modification, system sustainment, and ground/flight test operational mission support.

Essential Functions:

* Perform as a Windows\VMware System Administrator for a classified government contract.
* Perform as a Linux\Redhat System Administrator for a classified government contract.
* Maintain smooth operation of multi-user computer systems, including coordination with network, software, and system engineers, PC desktop technicians, project managers, end users, customer, and IT management.
* Analyze internal and external customer requirements and determine equipment and software requirements for solutions to problems.
* Review recommendations and system enhancements that will improve the performance and reliability of the system including installing, upgrading/patching, monitoring, problem resolution, and configuration management.
* Provide backup and recovery services; manage file systems and disk space; manage virus protection on a routine basis.
* Create and maintain user and computer accounts and modify file permissions and security access lists.
* Test new releases of products to ensure compatibility and minimize user impact.
* Develop and document technical processes and procedures as needed.
* Interface with multidiscipline team in the sustainment/evaluation/integration/system deficiency resolution with aircrew/engineering/management/customer/vendors.
* Adhere to strict Information Systems security guidelines.
* Maintain security audit and logging information on all classified networked and standalone computers by engineering guidelines.
* Prepare security documentation for input to Computer Security.
* Report on project status as required for all recurring and non-recurring efforts.
* Work under minimal direction and independently determine and develop approach to solutions.
* Responsible for providing engineering updates/adjudication for Interactive Electronic Technical Manuals.

We offer flexible work arrangements, 9/80 work schedule with every other Friday off, phenomenal learning opportunities, exposure to a wide variety of projects and customers, and a very friendly team environment. We are looking for self-motivated, proactive, and goal-oriented people to help us grow our services and become even better at what we do.

Basic Qualifications for Systems Administrator:

* Must have a Bachelor's degree AND 2 years of related professional/military experience, OR a Master's degree AND 0 years of related professional/military experience.

Basic Qualifications for Principal Systems Administrator:

* Must have a Bachelor's degree AND 6 years of related professional/military experience, OR a Master's degree AND 4 years of related professional/military experience, OR a Ph.D. AND 1 years of related professional/military experience.

Basic Qualifications for Both Levels:

* Must have an active US Government Top Secret Clearance (with a background investigation within the past 6 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation).
* Must have the ability to obtain and maintain Special Access Program (SAP) clearance, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by business needs.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an active SCI clearance within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company.
* Ability to obtain and maintain an active CI Polygraph within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company.
* Current Security + CE, or ability to obtain within 6 months of hire date.
* Ability to work after hours and weekends as needed.
* Experience managing Windows Server OS and domain architecture.
* Ability to support multiple networks, ensure necessary administration tasks are completed, and direct others as necessary.
* Ability to lift equipment weighing up to 40 pounds.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Active TS/SCI/CI Poly clearance
* Current valid Security+ CE, CASP, CISSP or similar security certification.
* Current valid DoD 8570 Certification in a primary OS (Windows, Linux, Cisco).
* Experience operating under and managing systems within NISPOM Chapter 8, DCID 6/3-ICD 503, RMF, STIG, JAFAN, or JSIG information system environments.
* Experience installing, configuring, and maintaining computer hardware in a networked environment.
* Understanding basic networking, including subnets, routing, and VLANs; Cisco experience and/or certification.
* Windows AD, LDAP, VMWare, and knowledge of SAN storage systems.
* Linux Operating System experience and/or certification for current versions.
* Rudimentary Scripting experience.
* Experience with the creation and deployment of system images in an enterprise environment. - Experience with Certification & Accreditation process.
* Working knowledge of DISA security STIGs and maintaining security best practices.

Job Title: Tier 2 Support Engineer/Systems Administrator

Job Description

The Tier 2 Support Engineer provides advanced technical support and troubleshooting for integrated hardware and software solutions in networking and communications, with a strong focus on voice and telecommunications systems. This role involves configuring and supporting software, networks, and proprietary communications equipment, participating in system installations and maintenance, and collaborating closely with cross-functional engineering and operations teams. You will play a key role in supporting air-to-ground voice systems for air traffic control centers as part of a growing operations department.

Responsibilities
• Provide advanced tier 2 technical support for software and hardware components, including software installation, configuration, and integration with telecommunications and voice systems.
• Configure and troubleshoot network components and IT system solutions, including computing platforms and proprietary communications equipment, across conceptual, functional, and physical views.
• Understand and follow detailed test procedures to verify system functionality and perform system debugging, including troubleshooting issues with customers over the phone.
• Create, review, and maintain technical documentation to support production builds, such as rack layouts, cable plans, system layouts, system configurations, bills of materials, and build plans or instructions.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams, including program management, hardware and software development, solution architecture, test engineering, field engineering, and production, to ensure overall project success.
• Support the system sustainment team by diagnosing and resolving software and hardware issues in deployed systems.
• Participate in on-site installations, integration, testing, and maintenance activities for voice and communications systems at customer locations.
• Perform remote system monitoring and maintenance and provide tier 2 on-call support as needed to ensure system reliability and performance.
• Apply best-practice second-level support concepts to improve support processes, documentation, and overall service quality.
• Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing detailed updates, documentation, and recommendations regarding system status and issue resolution.

Essential Skills
• 3–9 years of experience in a tier 2 support role integrating, deploying, and supporting integrated hardware and software solutions in networking and communications.
• Proven experience providing advanced technical support for hardware, software, and network components, including telecommunications and voice systems.
• Strong understanding of IT system solutions for networking, computing, and communications equipment, including conceptual, functional, and physical system views.
• Hands-on experience with software installation, configuration, and troubleshooting in complex environments.
• Experience following and executing formal test procedures to verify system functionality and performing systematic debugging.
• Ability to create and interpret technical documentation such as rack layouts, cable plans, system layouts, system configurations, bills of materials, and build instructions.
• Demonstrated ability to implement and apply best-practice second-level support concepts in an operational environment.
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and technical troubleshooting skills.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly.
• Experience working with operating systems such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and Windows.
• Willingness and ability to travel up to 20% based on project requirements for installations, testing, and on-site troubleshooting.

Additional Skills & Qualifications
• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, or equivalent experience with IT systems and/or engineering.
• Experience in networking and communications, particularly in environments involving voice and telecommunications systems.
• Experience supporting or integrating voice communication systems (VOICE/VCS) or similar mission-critical communication platforms.
• Familiarity with transitioning systems from analog to VoIP or working with VoIP-based communication solutions.
• Ability to work effectively with cross-functional engineering and operations teams in a project-based environment.
• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, documentation, and priorities in parallel.
• Customer-focused mindset with experience supporting external customers during installations, testing, and troubleshooting.
• Interest in contributing to a growing operations department and supporting the expansion of new service capabilities.

Work Environment

This role is based onsite in Columbia, MD, in an engineering and lab environment focused on configuring and testing voice communication systems before deployment to the field. You will work a standard Monday–Friday, 40-hour work week, with occasional on-call responsibilities for tier 2 support as required by project needs. The position involves up to 20% travel to customer sites for system installations, integration, testing, and on-site troubleshooting. You will work closely with engineering, test, and field teams, using modern lab equipment, networking gear, and telecommunications hardware to support air-to-ground voice systems for air traffic control centers within a collaborative and growth-oriented operations department.

Lanham, MD

We are seeking a highly capable Systems Administrator to serve as the primary IT lead for our Lanham, MD office while operating as part of a distributed enterprise IT operations team. This role requires a strong technical foundation across hybrid infrastructure, a high degree of ownership, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment.

This role requires a minimum of two days onsite per week, with additional onsite presence as needed to support business operations, projects, or critical incidents.
A day in the life of a Systems Administrator
• Serve as the primary IT owner for the Lanham office, ensuring reliability, performance, and user support
• Maintain and support hybrid infrastructure, including VMware ESXi environments, virtual machines, and cloud services
• Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 GCC High (Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams)
• Support and contribute to data center operations, including system health, maintenance, and incident response
• Act as a key escalation point for complex technical issues across the enterprise
• Partner with a distributed team of system administrators to support enterprise-wide help desk operations
• Drive improvements in system performance, standardization, and operational efficiency
• Support implementation and enforcement of security and compliance controls (CMMC, NIST 800-171, etc.)
• Respond to and lead troubleshooting during outages or critical incidents
Key Responsibilities:
• Provide hands-on support for onsite needs including workstation deployment, hardware replacement, and troubleshooting
• Manage and monitor virtual environments across on-prem and cloud platforms
• Participate in ticket triage, escalation, and resolution across a multi-site environment
• Maintain system documentation, procedures, and operational runbooks
• Collaborate with vendors and managed service providers when required
• Support infrastructure-related projects and site-specific initiatives
This role is for you if you:
• A self-starter who takes ownership and follows through without constant direction
• Comfortable being the go-to IT presence in an office environment
• Able to balance hands-on support with infrastructure-level responsibilities
• Calm under pressure and capable of navigating high-impact incidents
• Collaborative, but equally effective working independently
What we are expecting from you (i.e. the qualifications you must have):
• 8+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure support, or a similar role
• Proven experience managing hybrid IT environments (on-premises and cloud)
• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, preferably within GCC High or other regulated environments
• Deep experience with VMware ESXi and virtual infrastructure management
• Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint management
